execute_python_script.description: Execute a Python script. / 执行 Python 脚本。 The script MUST use the 'unreal' module for all engine interactions. / 脚本必须使用 'unreal' 模块进行所有引擎交互。 NEVER use os, subprocess, or shutil for asset operations. / 切勿使用 os、subprocess 或 shutil 进行资产操作。 EXAMPLE: Use unreal.EditorAssetLibrary.rename_asset() instead of os.rename().

reasoning_step.description: Explain what you are trying to achieve before writing the code. / 在编写代码之前解释你想要实现的目标。

script_content.description: The exact Python code to execute. / 要执行的确切 Python 代码。

execute_batch_blueprint_operations.description: Batch multiple Blueprint modifications in a single transaction. / 在单次事务中批量处理多个蓝图修改。 Plan your node injection and connections thoroughly before emitting the array. / 在提交数组之前彻底计划节点注入和连接。

reasoning_step.description: Step-by-step plan of which nodes to add and how they connect. / 逐步计划要添加哪些节点以及它们如何连接。

blueprint_path.description: The internal Unreal asset path to the Blueprint. / 蓝图的内部 Unreal 资产路径。

operations.description: Array of operation objects. / 操作对象数组。
